# jaff.cli.jaffgen.config

<!-- Generated by `python -m jaff._utils.api_docs`; do not edit. -->

Config of a code-generation run (`[jaffgen]`) and of a `jaffgen.toml` file.

`load_jaffgen_config` assembles a run's config from the network's
`jaff.toml`, the `jaffgen.toml` and the command line, in that order of
precedence (lowest first).

## Classes

| Class | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`JaffgenConfig`](jaffgenconfig/index.md) | Code-generation run (`[jaffgen]`, `jaffgen.toml` only). |
| [`JaffgenTomlConfig`](jaffgentomlconfig/index.md) | A `jaffgen.toml` file: a code-generation run and its network settings. |

## Functions

| Function | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`load_jaffgen_config`](load_jaffgen_config.md) | Load a code-generation run's config: jaff.toml < jaffgen.toml < command line. |
